capture_source: live capture 2026-11-25: the reference client (pyrfc 3.3.1 on the NW RFC SDK 7.50) calling Z_SAPRFCLIB_BCD (see bcd_sign.json; kernel 793) with importing values that carry more fraction digits than the field. IV_DEC is typed DMBTR, packed decimal 23 digits with 2 decimals, 12 bytes.
evidence: tier 1 live capture. 'input' is the Decimal handed to the reference client, 'hex' the IV_DEC bytes it put on the wire, 'echo' the value the server returned. The client rounds half away from zero, and a value that rounds to zero keeps its negative sign nibble.
